data.name: Prism 2033
data.detailed_description:
The Parallelverse Has No Boundaries Shape Your Destiny

Prism 2033 is a Futuristic Parallel-Universe MMORPG powered by Unreal Engine 5, planned for release on PC and mobile platforms.

Flux City lies at the heart of Prism 2033, serving as the central hub that connects parallel worlds. As a newly recruited Investigator of the civilian organization Harbor Agency, you will begin your journey here, working alongside fellow Investigators to complete missions, uncover hidden stories, and carve your own path across parallel worlds.

Each world presents unique environments, conflicts, and opportunities. Travel between worlds, take on new challenges, and help shape the future of the Parallverse.

A Living Parallel World

From vibrant futuristic cities to ancient floating realms, the world evolves over time — trees grow and wither, and seasons shift naturally.

Through advanced behavioral systems, NPCs are equipped with sensory awareness, allowing them to react differently to unexpected events and situations, creating a more immersive experience. Their growth and life cycles develop based on daily experiences, progressing from youth to old age.

Players can build meaningful relationships with NPCs, and in certain cases, raise children who inherit parental appearance traits, grow under your care, and form lasting emotional bonds.

Dynamic and Diverse Gameplay

Team up with friends to explore dangerous parallel worlds, tackle high-difficulty missions that test coordination, and fight alongside powerful allies.

Gather your guild members to command starships in large-scale interstellar fleet battles. Plan strategies, allocate resources, and engage in ongoing conflicts against rival forces.

Personalized Gameplay Experience

Not every session requires hours of commitment. Even short play sessions can provide meaningful rewards and progression.

Discover cosmetic outfits, stylish vehicles, and collectible content while exploring at your own pace.

The game supports player-driven world-building features, allowing you to create and customize your own space within the Parallelverse.

Development Vision

“Our goal is to push beyond the traditional boundaries of game development. As our architecture evolves and AI technology continues to advance, our ultimate ambition is to create a virtual world as vibrant as the one outside your window — a world where every character feels alive, every choice carries weight, and the world itself truly breathes.”

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64bit
  • Processor: Core i7-7700K / Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060(6GB) / RX 480(8GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 100 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: We recommend you install the game on SSD drive for better experience.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64bit
  • Processor: Core i7-10700 / Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2070 SUPER / RX 6700 XT / ARC A750
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 100 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: We recommend you install the game on SSD drive for better experience.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains combat and depictions of violence as part of its gameplay, including shooting and battles against enemies. Some scenes may include mild blood effects. No explicit sexual content is included.
